messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty alert — SEV2 for tenant auriga-prod-vpc: sustained 5xx + p99 latency spike on /v1/generate for last 4m. Paging @oncall-sre.
Olivia S.: taking it. I see repeated KV cache checksum mismatch log across the dedicated pool. Correlated evictions + OOM attempts on host gpu-auriga-07.
Ryan M.: looks like the quantized 4-bit variant (q4_1) started failing KV load; fallback variant q4_0 is healthy. We should pin the tenant to q4_0 or a safe variant until we stabilize KV.
Jess K.: I'm on the call with Sam at Auriga, they're seeing a spike in customer-facing errors. Sam, can we message them that we're applying a temporary model pin?
Sam R. (Auriga): yes please — let us know ETA. It's impacting batch scoring for their fraud-detection job. Non-blocking for UI but causes retries.
Olivia S.: mitigation options: 1) apply tenant override to pin model -> safevariant:q4_0 (fast, minimal change); 2) route to CPU-backed fallback pool -> higher latency but avoids GPU eviction; 3) restart kernels on gpu-auriga-07 (risky, may cause load). Recommend (1) immediate, (2) warm CPU fallback if pin isn't sufficient.
Raj P.: confirm SLO impact: p50 unaffected, p95 up from 180ms -> 750ms, error rate from 0.1% -> 3.2%. Need update for SLA page and customer comms.
Luca B.: I'll isolate gpu-auriga-07 from the autoscaler to stop further task placement. Doing `kubectl cordon gpu-auriga-07 && kgp --selector=auriga-pool`.
Ryan M.: to pin via control-plane API — run as infra-admin: `curl -X POST https://control.redwood/api/v1/tenants/auriga/overrides -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"model_pin":"redwood/q4_0-safe:2025-11-01","reason":"kv-checksum-evictions"}'`
Olivia S.: I'm applying the override now (will use infra-admin token, small TTL 30m).
Olivia S.: `HTTP 200` override accepted. System shows tenant override active -> model=redwood/q4_0-safe:2025-11-01.
Sam R. (Auriga): seeing errors drop on their end, p95 trending down. ETA ~2m for full convergence. Thank you.
Jess K.: noted. I'll send a short update to the Auriga CSM + their security contact documenting the temporary pin and expected rollback after fix.
Raj P.: PSA — capture metrics snapshot and attach to incident ticket. Increased error budget consumption recorded.
Luca B.: running quick KV consistency check on pool: `python infra/tools/kv_check.py --pool auriga --since 4281239000`
Ryan M.: also start loading a fresh kv-checkpoint to the cluster; suspected partial corruption from recent GC job. If pin holds, we'll promote q4_0 safe variant as default for auriga for 4 hours.
Olivia S.: monitoring — after pin, error rate back to 0.4% and p95 240ms. Good. Moving to mitigation->postmortem prep.
night-sre: taking over on-call for the night. Olivia — any open action items you want me to own?
Olivia S.: handoff: 1) keep override active until KV remediation is complete + we're stable for 30m; 2) latch in runbook: `auriga-kv-remediate` steps 1-4; 3) coordinate with Ryan for checkpoint restore. I'll update the incident ticket and add runbook links.
night-sre: got it. I'll also queue a follow-up to rollback the pin in 2 hours if metrics remain stable. :thumbsup:
Sam R. (Auriga): thanks team. Please CC me when you rollback so we can validate batch jobs.
Jess K.: will do. Closing immediate mitigation — creating internal follow-up to root cause and reliable KV checkpointing improvements.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigation in place. Incident owner: Olivia S. | Severity: SEV2 | ticket: INC-2026-4521
Olivia S.: adding note: potential next steps — tighter KV checksums at write-time, alerting on eviction patterns, and a canary restart plan for the auriga pool.
Luca B.: logging the node isolation actions and upload of `kv_check` logs to incident.
Raj P.: I'll prepare customer-facing summary for tomorrow's EBR.
night-sre: handover complete. Monitoring watch enabled for 3 hours.
Sam R. (Auriga): appreciate the quick response.
Olivia S.: thanks everyone.
